MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: One year of applicable experience that demonstrates the competencies necessary for immediate success in this position at the GS-13 grade level and that would be considered equivalent to work normally performed at the next lower grade level (GS-12) in the federal service which demonstrates the ability to perform the duties of the position, is required. Specialized Experience is defined as: Developing continuity and/or crisis management procedures, and guidelines pertaining to the allocation and use of resources for implementation within the organization; Validating the readiness of emergency relocation/continuity sites and information technology in support of emergency relocation groups; Supporting the analysis of risks and readiness gaps through continuity communications tests and the coordination of site readiness reviews; Managing emergency relocation/continuity site projects, overseeing the implementation of service agreements, and coordinating with internal and external support organizations to ensure site preparedness to support customers during continuity events and crisis scenarios. Volunteer Experience: Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Details.JobSummary: If you want to do interesting and challenging work and to make a contribution to national defense, DISA is a great place for you.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: DISA provides secure and reliable communications and computing support that enable the President and our military forces to communicate globally through voice, video, and data transmission. DISA is a leader within the Federal Government in implementing "people programs" and offers a broad range of quality-of-life and training programs.
